title: The Burnt Drop
author: Noor Eastwick
blurb: Astrid Almeida, a whistle-blower living under four names, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
